name: Kirishima-Kinkowan National Park
description: National park (1934) of the Kirishima volcano group with its crater lakes, and the Sakurajima peninsula and Kinko Bay coast of southern Kyushu.
notes: Designated 1934 (36,605 ha). Kirishima's hiking trails and the Sakurajima ferry views are the highlights.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
